gates.citation: van Hees VT, et al. (2013). Separating movement and gravity components in an acceleration signal (ENMO/ENMOa). PLoS ONE 8(4):e61691. Reference impl: GGIR (CRAN) g.applymetrics ENMOa. Data: PAMAP2 (PhysioNet/UCI), hand accel.

reference.citation: van Hees VT, et al. (2013). Separating movement and gravity components in an acceleration signal (ENMO/ENMOa). PLoS ONE 8(4):e61691. Reference impl: GGIR (CRAN) g.applymetrics ENMOa. Data: PAMAP2 (PhysioNet/UCI), hand accel.
reference.description: re-computes the per-epoch ENMOa with GGIR::g.applymetrics on the identical PAMAP2 hand-acc signal (749 epochs, both in g); reports the max abs difference, the correlation, the epoch count, the mean ENMOa (mg), that ENMOa >= ENMO, and the ENMOa-minus-ENMO gap (mg)
